answer: Vesting with forfeiture: each agent's rewards unlock slowly over about 100 epochs, so a new identity must keep doing real work for months before it can spend any of the nectar it earns. If answer similarity or shared timing, seen through the prism of the whole ledger, shows two identities run by one operator, every unvested coin in both is burned. A sybil farm must keep dozens of wallets alive, each holding a growing pile of locked value, so one exposure drains an ocean of pending rewards at once and every fake risks more than it could ever earn.
